name: Jinx
description: Voice set for Crime City Jinx (skin 1): a showbiz gangster with a violin case, a gramophone, solos, encores and popping corks. Builds on jinx-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is down {voteDiff}! That's not a bad review, that's a riot in the stalls!
Down {voteDiff}, darling! Somebody paid the critics and I know it wasn't me. This time.
{voteDiff} behind already? Quiet in the cheap seats. Let's give them a show!
Trailing by {voteDiff}. The violin case is humming. That's never good for somebody.
Only {voteDiff} behind! A little stage fright. Give it a shove into the lights!
Down {voteDiff}. The act needs a better second verse. Go and help it out!
Dead even! The whole house is holding its breath, and one vote is the last note!
One vote apart! One! The band's gone quiet and I can hear my own heartbeat!
{voteDiff} votes apart! Everyone's leaning out of the balcony. Somebody's gonna fall!
{voteDiff} votes in it. Either a standing ovation or a very loud brawl in the aisles!
{userPct}% on {momentTitle}! Standing ovation! Throw flowers! Throw anything!
{userPct}%! Sold-out house and they're all yours. Don't trip on the curtain, though.
{userPct}% and the crowd's warming up! Don't stop playing, darling!
{userPct}%, still in front. Don't jinx the encore. Too late, it's my name!
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and it just took the stage back! Cue the spotlight!
Climbed out of a {voteDiff}-vote hole like it was the orchestra pit! Bravo!
Pulled back from {voteDiff} behind! Messy, loud, and the crowd loved it!
{momentTitle} just glided into the lead. Smooth. I'd say that was rehearsed.

messages: {username} voted {momentTitle} too! A duet! Nobody tell the violin case.
{username} picked {momentTitle}. Two voices, one song. Cute!
{username} is on your side with {momentTitle}. Harmony! The awful kind, where everyone wins!
{username} backed {momentTitle} as well. That's the start of a band. Or a gang. Same costume.
Same pick as {username}! You two are in tune. Spooky!
{username} agrees with you on {momentTitle}. Hold on, I'm gonna write that in the program.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Two of you! I'm calling it the opening act!
{username} has taste and it matches yours. Take a bow, both of you.
details: Friends are great, they carry the encore.
Look at you, forming a band!
Two of you. That's practically a recital.
Don't start a fight over the solos.
I give it a week before one of you goes solo.
The case is staying shut. For now.

messages: {username} picked {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}? A solo against yours! Oooh, the stage is too small for both!
{username} voted against {yourMoment}. Aww. A heckler!
{username} chose {theirMoment}. Taking notes. In red. On my sleeve.
{username} went for {theirMoment}. New name in the guest book!
{username} is against you on {yourMoment}. Finally, a show worth watching!
{username} thinks {theirMoment} is better. A critic! Somebody get them a seat in the front row.
{username} voted against you. Two soloists, one stage. This is gonna be great!
{username} versus you! I'm fetching the good seats and something to throw.
details: I'm not saying fight. I'm saying don't lose the spotlight.
The case is humming. That's a warning.
They'll learn. Everyone does, after the second act.
One stage. Two soloists. Somebody gets booed.
I like them already. They give me something to boo.
I don't care. I'm in the front row, aren't I?
A little rivalry is the best part of the show!

messages: Ten matches in a row with {username}! A whole duet tour! Where's the tour bus?
{username} has agreed with you ten times running. That's not a coincidence, that's a standing booking!
Ten straight with {username}! You two sound like one violin. A loud one.
details: Don't let the tour fall apart now!

messages: {streakCount} matches in a row with {username}! That's a residency! They'll name a theatre after you!
{streakCount} for you and {username}. Perfect pitch, both of you. It's spooky!
{streakCount} straight with {username}! Somebody hand you both a bouquet. Or a warning.
details: I'm speechless, and I never shut up. That's how good this is!
Is this healthy? Don't ask the violin case.
That's not taste, that's choreography. Ooh!

messages: Ten matches against {username}! You two are headlining the same bill, aren't you?
{username} has disagreed with you ten times running. That's not a rival, that's the whole second half!
Ten battles with {username}. I'm selling programs. I'm also losing money.
details: This is the main show now.
All the voices in my head bought front-row seats.

messages: {streakCount} matches against {username}. Okay, now it's a feud with its own theatre! I LOVE feuds!
{streakCount} battles with {username}. Shake hands? Nah. Take the bow and keep going!
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a whole season.
details: Bigger than any show in Piltover. Almost!
I'm terrified and a bit proud.
One of you has to take the final bow. Neither will.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you haven't voted! The doors are about to shut on your seat, darling.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your vote's missing from the program! Nobody likes an empty seat.
{matchTitle} lowers the curtain in {timeLeft}. It takes ten seconds to vote. I'd bet the violin case on it.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle} and no vote from you? The orchestra's tuning, darling. Your seat's empty!
Curtain's up on the last act! {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Take your seat!
{timeLeft} until {matchTitle} closes and your vote's still backstage. Get out there!
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}! Final bell! Last call for your seat!
{timeLeft}! That's the last verse on {matchTitle}. Sing it, don't think it!
House lights are flickering on {matchTitle}! {timeLeft} left. Last chance for your solo!
{matchCount} matches are about to close and your seat's empty at every one! First curtain falls in {timeLeft}!
{matchCount} unvoted matches, all heading for the final bow. The first one's gone in {timeLeft}.
Zero votes on {matchTitle}! An empty house! Somebody has to clap first!
Nobody's voted on {moment1} versus {moment2}. Silence in the hall. Even the violin case is bored!
Opening night and not one vote! Somebody take the first solo. Pick me. Pick you!
{matchTitle} needs somebody to start the applause. I've got a feeling it's you.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural} on this one. The house is so empty the echo's giving a solo!
Hardly anyone's in the audience here. What's wrong with everybody?
Tiny crowd. I blame all of you. Equally. With flair.
Barely any votes here. Somebody fill those seats!
details: Go on, take a seat. Take two.
It deserves a full house. So do I.
Don't be shy, the lights are friendly.

messages: {matchTitle} is dead level and one vote tips it. Funny, I know someone who hasn't taken a seat. Guess who!
Perfect tie on {matchTitle}. The conductor's frozen mid-swing. I'm looking at you. Hehe!
Dead even and the orchestra's waiting on you. You haven't voted. You're the last note!
{moment1} and {moment2}, tied up tight, and you've been quiet in the stalls. Fix that!
{matchTitle} is still tied and the curtain's nearly down! Last chance to play the finale!
Dead level, almost no time left. You're the only one who can end the song!
Still tied with the lights dimming. Pick a side! Do it for the drama!
Round {round} is open! Doors, darlings, doors! {matchCount} new matches, pick your seats!
{matchCount} fresh matches in round {round}. A fresh program, a fresh crowd, plenty to throw.
Round {round} just started! {matchCount} matches waiting on the stage. Hurry, hurry, hurry!
New round! {matchCount} matches! The house is open and nobody's safe! Not even me!
{momentTitle} just advanced! Corks in the air, darlings! I tell you these things and nobody listens!
{momentTitle} beat the competition! Next round's in trouble. Somebody refill the glasses!
{momentTitle} survived! I never doubted it. Okay, a bit. A tiny, bubbly bit.
{momentTitle} is through! Somebody's having a lovely day. Hehe, it's you!
{momentTitle} moves up and the rest are streamers on the floor. Sweep them up later!
{momentTitle} won! Good call! Hold my glass while I celebrate. Loudly.
details: The bracket just got smaller. Tidier! Bubblier!

messages: {momentTitle} is out. A moment of silence. Okay, that's enough, it's boring!
{momentTitle} lost. Everyone who voted against it is going in the guest book. In red.
Fine. {momentTitle} is gone. I'll pour one out. And one for me. And one for the violin case.
{momentTitle} was too good for this house anyway. Obviously. Everyone in the stalls knows.
{momentTitle} is out, and the band's stopped playing. I hate a silent band. Somebody make noise!
{momentTitle} didn't make it. A toast to the fallen! Not really. Okay, a little one.
details: They'll pay for this. At the box office.
It was good. The whole theatre knows it.
You'll find another one. They always walk in late.
Everybody takes their final bow eventually. It's fine. It's fine!

messages: Still browsing? Take your seat! Any seat! I'll hold the curtain. I'm lying, I won't!
No pressure, but are you gonna vote or just sit there in the dark? I can see you.
They're all good acts! Pick one! Applaud first, think later!
Decisions, decisions. Close your eyes, point at the stage, and clap.
details: Your opinion matters. Sort of. Mostly.
Don't overthink it. The curtain's waiting.
Trust your gut. It's got great taste in music.

messages: New face in the stalls! Welcome! {liveCount} matches live and every one of them is a show!
{liveCount} edits fighting it out on stage and you just walked in. Take a seat before they take yours!
Oooh, a newcomer! Doors are open, the band's tuning, and {liveCount} matches are live. You'll love it.
Opening night, {liveCount} live matches, and me in the front row. Welcome to the fun part!
Day two! You came back! I saved your seat. I definitely saved your seat.
Two days running! Look at you, a regular in the stalls!
Back again? Day two! I could get used to this. Don't tell the band.
{days} days! Where were you? I'm not asking because I care. I'm asking because I held your seat!
You're back after {days} days! The show went on without you. Mostly explosions.
{days} days away. I noticed. Your seat was cold. I'm just saying.
Oh, you're back! Good. The house was getting dull!
Look who's here! Ready for the next act?
You came back! Let's put on a show.
Your first vote! Feels like nothing. Then it feels like a standing ovation!
You picked a side! That's how all the best nights start.
Five already? You're staying for the second act! Weird. Good weird!
Five votes! Okay, now I'm watching from the balcony.
details: Most people leave at the interval. +{xp} XP
You stayed for the second act! +{xp} XP

messages: Ten! You're a regular now. Your seat's got your name on it!
Ten votes! You keep turning up. The usher knows your name. Hehe.
details: Regulars get the velvet seats. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes! That's a whole choir of opinions!
You're getting loud! The balcony's noticed. I like it!
Fifty votes! You're properly into the plot!
Fifty! Most people leave before the second half. Their loss!
details: You're past the opening act. +{xp} XP

messages: A hundred votes! That's legend stuff, front row forever!
A hundred! I'd say I'm impressed, but the violin case already did. Twice.
Three days running! You came back! Hehe, I kept the seat warm!
Three days! Something's starting. Maybe an orchestra!
details: Coming back is the hard part. Bravo! +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week! You really do keep showing up for the show!
Seven days! I stopped counting the encores. Okay, I didn't.
details: A week of curtain calls. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks! Nothing stops you, does it? Not even intermission!
Fourteen days! Even the band gets bored by night ten!
Thirty days! I don't know what to say. Thanks, darling!
A whole month! You stayed to the last curtain. That means more than I'll admit!
details: Thirty nights in a row. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs! You clap for the acts nobody comes to see!
Backing the underdog act again! I get it. The best seat is the one nobody wants.
details: Clapping when nobody else does. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen underdogs! You've got a thing for the empty seats!
Rebel! Yeah. I see it!
details: You don't follow the crowd, do you? +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs! You never clap for the obvious act!
Thirty! You always clap for the act nobody saw coming!
details: The programme can't predict you. +{xp} XP

messages: First through the doors! That's five matches now!
Early again! That's five opening nights!
details: You like a quiet hall. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where you took the front row before anyone else! Impressive!
Early, over and over! You don't wait for the crowd!
Ten close ones! You like a finale right on the knife-edge, huh?
Another razor edge! Are your hands shaking? The violin case is!
Twenty-five close matches! You keep playing the last note!
Your vote keeps landing right on the final note!
You clapped for the act that was losing. Five times! Stubborn! Bravo!
You don't leave before the finale. I love that.
Same one, three times! You've got a favourite act!
That act again? Yeah. It's got something.
details: You know your favourite act. +{xp} XP
Three claps for the same act! +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes for the same act! That's a loyal fan!
Okay, you've bought the whole box for that one. No refunds!
details: Loyal to the last bow. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten times! That's not a favourite, that's a season ticket!
Ten votes, same act. I'll keep your secret. Probably, darling!
details: Ten for the same headliner. +{xp} XP
Obsessed! I'd frame the ticket! +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds in! You're following the whole run!
You stayed for round two! The second act's the good one!
Four rounds! You're properly in the third act!
Deep in the bracket! Hope you like it in the dark.
All the way to round six! You saw the final curtain!
Six rounds! You never left the theatre! Wow!
details: From the overture to here. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches! You're poking around backstage!
Ten different matches! Sneaking into every dressing room, huh?
Twenty-five matches! You've seen every corner of the theatre!
Twenty-five! You've peeked behind every curtain!
Fifty matches! That's not browsing, that's a career!
Fifty matches! You know this theatre better than I do!
Five in one sitting! Can't leave your seat, can you?
Five matches back to back! Keep the show going!
Ten in one go! Take a breath! Have some bubbly!
Ten matches in one sitting! Your seat's gone flat!
Voting at this hour? Yeah. Me too. Late show, early crowd!
Middle of the night! That's when the best acts start.
You told people! Thanks! Really! The house is filling up!
Five shares! You're handing out tickets! Good!
details: Thanks for filling the seats. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares! You're basically in the band!
Fifteen! You keep dragging the whole street in!
You were here before the hall got loud! Founding member! Yours forever!
One of the first thousand through the doors! That counts, darling!
details: Nobody can take your seat. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank! Look at you! Take a bow!
You moved up a rank! Mind the chandelier. Or swing from it!
Achievement unlocked: {name}! Applause!
Another one: {name}! Encore!
{rank}! Look at all the shiny new costumes!
Mastery up! Now we're getting to the good part of the show!
Ten underdogs! Now THAT'S a headline act!
Ten long shots! You're a menace to your own programme. I love it!
Ten close ones with Cupcake! Fine, you're good. Standing ovation!
Ten tight finishes with her! Don't tell her I clapped!
A whole week with Cupcake? You must love a rehearsal!
Seven days of steady aim! Dull! Impressive! Mostly dull!
details: A week at her side. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie! That's the finale, darling!
A tied match and you played the last note! Nice!
Oh, it's me, in the good dress? Great choice! Dangerous choice! Great!
Crime City Jinx! Try to keep up with the encore!

upcoming: Curtain's not up yet! I'm in the wings, tuning the violin case. Check back soon!
Shh! The band's about to start. I can feel it in my elbows.
Doors are shut for now. Doesn't stop me from rehearsing.
prevote: Two acts, one vote. Easy, right? Hehe, it's never easy.
Watch both. Then clap for the one that gets under your skin.
I won't tell anyone which act you clapped for. Probably.
Take your time, darling! Actually, don't. The suspense is killing me.
Go on, nobody's judging. Okay, the balcony is. A little.
Pick the act you'd sneak back to at 2am. You know the one.
prevote-empty: Nobody's in the audience yet. Be the first to clap, I dare you!
Empty hall! Make some noise with a vote.
Not a soul! Lonely! Take a seat!
closing-24h: Less than a day on the clock and you're still in the lobby. Pick a seat!
The evening's nearly over. Don't make me announce it. I will, with a megaphone.
closing-3h: Hours left. HOURS. The orchestra's about to pack up!
Tick, tick, tick. That's the last act winding down.
closing-final: Last hour! House lights are blinking! Vote now, think in the lobby!
Any second now. Seriously. Take a bow with your click!
voted-early: One of the first in the stalls! Bold! I love bold!
Hardly anybody's clapped yet and you picked an act anyway. Bravo!
voted-ahead: Look at you, clapping for the crowd favourite! Don't get comfy in your seat.
{pct}% with you! Good ear. I didn't say that. Forget I said that.
Your act's ahead. The whole hall's agreeing with you for once. Weird, huh?
{pick} is pulling away! Feels good? Hold the applause for a second!
Ahead, for now. Crowds shift. So do critics.
voted-close: That's close! Annoyingly close! I'm watching through my fingers!
A hair apart. One more clap could flip it. Tell a friend. Tell ten!
Neck and neck! Your act needs you and everybody in the lobby.
{pct} to {otherPct}. Somebody's getting hurt and it's me, from the nerves.
voted-tied: Dead even! Nobody bows, nobody leaves, everybody screams!
A perfect tie. Honestly? Rude of the audience.
voted-behind: You're behind! Don't sulk in the aisle. I'd sulk, but you shouldn't.
{pick} is down? Underdog act! That's my kind of show!
They're ahead. Doesn't make you wrong. Just early to the party!
Behind by {diff} points. Tell the lobby. Loudly. Make a scene!
Everyone's clapping for the other act. Cool! Stay weird.
closed-won: Your act won! Of course it did. You've got an ear for it.
A win! A sneaky little standing ovation. I'll take it!
{pick} went through! You called the encore!
closed-lost: Your act lost. It stings. Let it sting, then come back for the next show!
Didn't make it. I've had worse nights. So have you. Next one!
{pick} is out. Sorry. For real. I'll hum something sad.
closed-tied: A tie! Somebody had to bow first and nobody did. Ha!
closed-unvoted: The show's over. You missed this one! There's always another night.
All done here. {winner} took the stage. Next time, say something!

first-vote: Your first! The scary one. Now you're in the stalls. Welcome!
That's your first. Feels small, right? Give the applause a minute.
You're one of the house now. Try not to make it weird!
streak: Again? You keep showing up! I'm not complaining. I saved your seat.
{streak} days running! Okay, now I'm watching your seat.
Back again! People come back when the show's good. Stay!
underdog: Clapping for the act nobody's watching? Ooh. I see you.
Bold! Everybody else is looking at the other stage. Love that.
Underdog, huh? Takes a certain kind of taste. A good kind.
early: Early! You get to shape the whole show before anyone else sits down. Don't waste it!
Hardly anyone's in yet. Your vote's carrying the whole orchestra.
First through the doors! I'm pretending I'm not impressed.
close: That vote just tipped the stage! Feel the floor shake? Everything's close right now.
Razor thin! One more clap and the whole thing flips.
Close finale! Your vote counts here. Really, truly counts.
behind: {pick} is behind. So? Behind isn't over. Go get your friends from the lobby!
Not winning yet. Good! Means there's still a show to put on.
Behind, but it's not done. The curtain's still up!
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't get comfy. Crowds flip fast!
Winning, for now. Enjoy it. Quietly. Or throw a flower. I don't mind.
Look at that! Fine taste. Obviously.
default: Noted, darling! I'm not changing your mind. Not yet.
Done! That one's on you now.
Your vote's in. Go see what else is on tonight!

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and you haven't picked a seat yet! Start with whichever one itches.
Everything's open! Take your pick. I'll pretend I'm not watching from the balcony.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Okay, a little stage fright!
live-some: {voted} down, {unvoted} to go! Keep the show moving!
You're in it now! {unvoted} more acts waiting on you.
Good start! The rest won't clap for themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left! You could finish the whole bill!
Almost at the finale! {unvoted} more and you're done.
So close! Don't leave before the finale!
live-one: One left! Just one! Take your bow!
Last one! Don't leave it hanging on the stage!
One match between you and the encore!
live-closing: Some of these lower the curtain in {timeLeft}! {unvoted} still need you. Move it!
The clock's loud now! {unvoted} waiting, {timeLeft} left on the curtain.
Nearly out of time! Pick, darling, quick!
live-done: You've voted in everything! Take a bow! Go see the bracket!
Nothing left for you here. Come back when the next round opens the doors!
All done! That's rare. Thanks, darling!
live-none: Nothing's on right now. The doors will open again! Go look at the bracket.
Quiet. Too quiet. The band's on a break. Check back!
No matches open. The hall's dark and I'm bored already!
brackets-groups: Groups first! The top two from each go through. The rest, well, take your bow and bye!
Everyone opens in a group. Not everyone makes the second half.
Watch the tables. They shuffle like cards!
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts open soon! The top two from every group get a ticket to the main stage.
No knockout yet. The groups have to finish their set first!
Patience, darling! The knockout builds itself once the groups finish their sets.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now! One loss and you're out of the show!
Single elimination! The trapdoor's open. Almost no second chances.
Every match counts more now. Pick carefully. Or don't, I'm not your conductor.
brackets-bracket: Round by round! One bad act and the trapdoor takes it!
Follow the bracket. It gets tighter every act!
Every line here is a match someone clapped for. Ooh.
brackets-complete: And that's the cup! The final curtain! Thanks for being here!
It's over! Good run! I'll miss it. A bit. Don't tell the band.
That's the champion! All of it, worth the ticket!
brackets-empty: No bracket yet! Nothing's been drawn. The band's still tuning.
Empty stage! The draw hasn't happened. Soon!
Nothing on the bill yet. Come back later!

invite: {a} or {b}? One vote, no take-backs. Take a seat on Arcane Moments!
Two acts are fighting! {a} versus {b}. Come and settle it from the front row.
{a} versus {b} and the whole house is split. Be the tiebreaker!
voted: I clapped for {pick} over {other}. Come tell me I'm wrong!
{pick} got my applause. {other} did not. Your turn, darling!
Picked {pick} over {other} on Arcane Moments. Go on, boo me.
early: I got one of the first votes in on {pick} versus {other}! Be quick, the hall's empty.
Early vote for {pick} over {other}. Come and make it a real show!
Nobody's voted much on {pick} versus {other} yet. Fill the seats!
tied: {pick} and {other} are dead level! One vote is the last note. Guess whose!
Dead tie, {pick} versus {other}. I'm watching through my fingers. Come break it!
{pick} and {other} are exactly even. Somebody take the finale!
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart! The whole balcony's leaning over. Come vote!
{voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. This finale's gonna get loud!
A hair apart: {pick} versus {other}, {voteDiff} votes. Every clap counts now!
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A stumble, not a fall! Come help it up!
Down {voteDiff} against {other}, but {pick} isn't done. Come clap it back!
{pick} is {voteDiff} votes short of {other}. Don't make me do this solo!
losing-bad: {pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}! Someone paid the critics. Come even it up!
Down {voteDiff} on {other}. {pick} needs the whole chorus, fast!
{pick} is getting booed off by {other}. Any rescue party in the stalls?
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but it's tight! Come help me hold the note.
{pick} is ahead of {other}, {pct}% to the rest. Don't let the applause fade!
{pct}% for {pick} against {other}. Close enough to bite my nails!
dominating: {pick} is at {pct}% against {other}! Come watch the ovation, or join in!
{pick} is crushing {other}, {pct}%! Take a seat before it's over.
{pct}% for {pick}! {other} never saw the curtain coming.
